title: NIST news: MEP Centers Aid Manufacturers on Cybersecurity (May 3, 2018)

history.reason: Source fetched and read directly on the access date; findings transcribed from the document.

reliability: US government (NIST MEP) document; MEP funds and promotes the assistance it describes, so it has an interest in presenting need for that assistance.
findings: NIST states: "Since 2017, the MEP National Network has provided direct assistance to over 1100 DoD contractors."
NIST states Handbook 162 "has been downloaded over 13,000 times" since its November 2017 publication.

NIST states MEP Centers guide small and medium-sized manufacturers through self-assessment against the Cybersecurity Framework, and help DoD-supply-chain manufacturers meet DFARS requirements via NIST SP 800-171.
The release includes a client testimonial (Flexfab LLC) saying it completed an SSP and POA&M with its MEP and was working toward full compliance in 2018.
limitations: Dated May 2018; counts are cumulative to that date and not updated here.
Assistance counts are outputs of a federally funded program, not measures of unmet need, outcomes or compliance; downloads are not unique users or manufacturers.
